name: Motivation
overview: Scripture reveals that true motivation flows from trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, recognizing that God is everlasting and never weary (Proverbs 3:5; Isaiah 40:28). When believers face lack of motivation or troubles, they can cry out to the Lord who hears and delivers them (Psalms 34:17). God’s intentions toward His people are always for their good and hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11), and with God, all things, including overcoming obstacles to motivation, are possible (Matthew 19:26). Believers are also cautioned to ensure their actions are motivated by sincere devotion to God rather than seeking human approval (Matthew 6:1).
